name: ABSORB — Nelson–Phelps directed-absorption catch-up (closed-form + 1-D FD)
summary: Process: two-tree Cobb-Douglas complements, U = delta[beta log C_d + (1-beta) log C_g] - delta logN(Y), beta=0.34, sectors self-financing (C_d=(A_d-i_d)K_d, C_g=(A_g(s)-i_g-i_r)K_g); innovation is a DETERMINISTIC embodied ladder: green productivity A_g(s) rises logistically 0.1085 -> 0.1567 in knowledge intensity s = logR - logK_g, with production's R&D technology dlogR = [psi0 i_r^{1/2} e^{-s/2} - sigma_r^2/2]dt + sigma_r dW_r (i_r = I_r/K_g competing with i_g inside the green budget); climate is intensity-form and uncontrollable, dY = iota(thetabar dt + varsigma dW_y), iota = eta A_d(1-Z0)K0 = 10.01, damage jump KEPT (it reprices only the closed-form climate account); xi = infinity member (documented neutral pole). Coupling story: the transition as an engineering program with certain returns and a knowledge-dilution wedge [(1-beta)-F'] taxing green scale-up — the climate-orthogonal foil. Value separates exactly: V = beta logK_d + b_d + (1-beta) logK_g + F(s) + w_reg(Y). Corrections applied per critique: (i) post-damage climate constant now carries the matching term lambda3(l)/2*yhat^2 (use the repo's value+slope-continuous damage coefficients, NOT the paper's typo form); (ii) ladder widened tau = 1.25 (s_m = s0 + tau ln 19 = -0.326) with the gate max_s F'(s) < 1-beta = 0.66 and safeguarded Newton, so the i_g FOC stays interior; (iii) LIFT BUDGET FIX: pre-tech policy targets are NOT the native ladder policies (confirmed infeasible: C/K < 0 at high Z under production A_g = 0.1085) but production-FOC-consistent policies re-solved at the lifted gradients; (iv) F solved on s in [-8, 7] covering the full production box image, right far field anchored by closed-form F(+inf).
solution_formulas: Dirty block (algebraic): i_d* = (Gamma theta A_d - delta)/(theta(delta+Gamma)) = 0.10313, phi_d* = 0.02509, c_d = 0.02717, b_d = beta[log(A_d - i_d*) + (phi_d* - sigma_d^2/2)/delta]. Green/knowledge block, 1-D elliptic ODE on s in [-8,7], 400->1600 nodes, upwind first-order/central second, Howard + safeguarded Newton: 0 = -delta F + max_{i_g,i_r>=0}{ delta(1-beta) log(A_g(s)-i_g-i_r) + [(1-beta)-F'][phi(i_g)-sigma_g^2/2] + F'[psi0 i_r^{1/2} e^{-s/2} - sigma_r^2/2] } + (sigma_g^2+sigma_r^2)/2 F''; FOCs delta(1-beta)/c_g = phi'(i_g)[(1-beta)-F'] = (psi0/2) i_r^{-1/2} e^{-s/2} F' giving i_r = [psi0 e^{-s/2} F' c_g/(2 delta(1-beta))]^2; A_g(s) logistic with A_g(s0)=0.1085 at s0 = log(11.2/616) = -4.007, tau = 1.25; right BC F(+inf) = (1-beta)[log(A_g''-i_g'') + (phi(i_g'')-sigma_g^2/2)/delta], i_g'' = 0.12576. Climate account: post-damage-l CLOSED FORM w^l(Y) = -(a_l Y^2 + b_l Y + c_l) with a_l = (lambda2+lambda3(l))/2, b_l = (lambda1 - lambda3(l) yhat) + 2 a_l iota thetabar/delta, c_l = (lambda3(l)/2) yhat^2 + (b_l iota thetabar + a_l iota^2 varsigma^2)/delta  [lambda0 correction; l=5 check: a=0.16887, b=-0.2044]; pre-damage: linear 1-D BVP delta w = -delta(lambda1 Y + lambda2/2 Y^2) + iota thetabar w' + iota^2 varsigma^2/2 w'' + Sum_l (1/5) J_n(Y)[w^l(Y) - w] on Y in [0,4], direct sparse solve.
lift_map: Shares ALL four production states bijectively: logK_d = logK + log(1-Z), logK_g = logK + logZ, s = logR - logK - logZ, Y shared; nothing collapsed. Value: v(x) = logK + beta log(1-Z) + (1-beta) logZ + b_d + F(s) + w_reg(Y; lambda3) with lambda3 entering EXACTLY through the closed-form quadratics (post-damage nets) and w_pre for pre-damage nets; post-tech regimes use F(+inf); logxi input: constant (documented neutral member). Policies: pre-tech regimes MUST use the map builder's FOC-CONSISTENT mode — Newton-solve the production 3-FOC + budget system at the lifted gradients v_logK = 1 - F'(s), v_Z = -beta/(1-Z) + (1-beta)/Z - F'(s)/Z, v_logR = F'(s) under production A_g = 0.1085, guaranteeing C/K > 0 box-wide while keeping the value imprint; i_r target therefore nontrivial in logR, logK, AND Z. Post-tech: i_d = 0.10313, i_g = 0.12576 constants, no i_r net (matches layout). Delivered as maps/absorb.py fields() for make_map_anchor.py.
plots: (1) Catch-up diagram: A_g(s), F(s), i_g(s), i_r(s) on s in [-7,3] with s0 and the A_g = A_d crossing marked. (2) Climate accounts: w_pre(Y) and the five closed-form w^l(Y) overlaid with the jump window [1.5,2.5] shaded. (3) Lifted fields: FOC-consistent i_r heatmap over (logR, Z) at logK = 6.78 plus the i_d field — the exact panels the anchor fit consumes.
